packages.readOnly: Your role can see the Packages but not change them.

blocked.no_payment_method: A card is required before a Package can be chosen or changed.
blocked.suspended: The team is suspended over an unpaid invoice; Packages cannot be chosen or changed until it is paid.

choose.title: Switch Mail on with {package}?
choose.description: {count} emails a month for {price} a month, on the team's monthly invoice. Sending can start once a sending domain is verified.

upgrade.title: Upgrade to {package} now?
upgrade.description: It takes effect at once: this month's allowance becomes {count} emails and what was already sent stays counted. This month is charged at {price}, the largest Package held in it.

downgrade.title: Move to {package} on {date}?
downgrade.description: Your current Package stays until the month ends. From {date} the allowance is {count} emails for {price} a month. You can undo this until then.

cancel.title: Cancel Mail?
cancel.description: {package} stays until the month ends; sending stops on {date}. You can undo this until then.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: This month's allowance and today's Daily limit.
usage.noPeriod: Nothing is counted until a Package is chosen.
usage.dailyRule: The Daily limit grows after days of clean sending, never beyond what the Package has left.

rates.title: Last {days} days
rates.description: Bounce and complaint rates decide whether sending is warned or paused.
rates.minimum: Rates count once at least {count} messages were sent in the window.

active.title: Sending is on
active.description: Your software can send from verified domains, within today's Daily limit and this month's allowance.

no_package.title: Mail is off
no_package.description: Choose a Package to start sending from this project.

exhausted.title: This month's emails are used up
exhausted.description: Sending is stopped until you upgrade, or until the allowance renews on {renews}.

daily_limit.title: Today's Daily limit is reached
daily_limit.description: Sending resumes at {resets}. The limit grows after days of clean sending.

suspended.title: Sending is stopped
suspended.description: The team has an unpaid invoice. Sending resumes as soon as it is paid.

pause.title: Sending was paused on {date}
pause.bounce: The bounce rate of the last {days} days reached {rate}; sending pauses at {limit}.
pause.complaint: The complaint rate of the last {days} days reached {rate}; sending pauses at {limit}.
pause.lift: Only Nodera can lift a Pause. Clean your recipient list, then contact support.

smtp.title: SMTP settings
smtp.description: For ready-made applications such as WordPress, Laravel or Django.
smtp.passwordValue: An API key of this project.
smtp.askForKey: Ask an owner or a developer for one.
smtp.tls: Credentials are accepted only over an encrypted connection: STARTTLS on 587 and 2525, TLS from the start on 465.

api.title: HTTP API
api.description: Send from your own software with an API key of this project.
api.notConfigured: The API address is not configured for this build.
api.keyHint: The command reads the key from {variable}: set it first with export {variable}=…, or paste the key in its place.
api.askForKey: Ask an owner or a developer for a key.
api.needsDomain: This project has no verified Sending domain yet, so the command is refused until its From address is on one.

example.subject: Hello from Nodera
example.text: It works: this message was sent through the Nodera Mail API.

testMessage.title: Send a test message
testMessage.description: Run this command in a terminal. The message shows up here the moment Nodera accepts it.
testMessage.needsDomain: This project has no verified Sending domain yet, so the command is refused until its From address is on one.
testMessage.waitingHint: The next message this project accepts appears here, followed by what became of each recipient.
testMessage.expiredHint: If the command answered with an error, its message says why, such as a From address outside a verified Sending domain.
testMessage.stalled: New messages could not be checked.

domains.title: Sending domains
domains.description: Domains {project} sends from. Each is verified through three DNS records.
domains.limitReached: A project can have at most {max} sending domains.
domains.emptyDescription: Mail leaves only from a verified domain. Add yours and Nodera shows the three DNS records to create.
domains.emptyReadOnly: No sending domain yet. Owners and developers can add one.

form.description: Enter the domain your addresses use, such as example.com or mail.example.com. You then add three CNAME records at your DNS provider.
form.name: Domain
form.nameHint: Without http:// or an address; a subdomain works too.
form.nameTooLong: The domain can have at most {max} characters.
form.nameFormat: Enter a domain like example.com, without http:// or an address.
form.duplicate: This domain is already in this project.
form.created: {name} added. Create its DNS records next.

detail.title: Sending domain
detail.description: Add the records below at your DNS provider; Nodera verifies the domain as soon as they answer.

explanation.pending: Waiting for the DNS records. Nodera checks them every 10 minutes during the first 72 hours, then daily; {domain} is verified the moment all three answer.
explanation.verified: All three records answer. Mail can be sent from any address at {domain}.
explanation.unverified: A record no longer answers as expected, so sending from {domain} is stopped. Fix the record marked below; the domain is verified again once all three answer.

detail.stillMissing: Checked: a record is still missing or points elsewhere.
detail.deleteConfirm: Nothing more is sent from it, from this moment. Its messages stay in the logs until they expire.
detail.notFoundDescription: It may have been deleted, or it belongs to another project.
detail.recordsDescription: Create these three CNAME records at your DNS provider. They are unique to this project.
detail.recordsHint: Some DNS providers add {domain} to the host on their own; there, enter only the part before .{domain}.

dmarc.title: No DMARC record found
dmarc.description: Large mailbox providers such as Gmail and Yahoo may refuse or junk mail from domains without one. Sending is not blocked; add a TXT record like this one:

eventDescriptions.accepted: Nodera took the message for this recipient.
eventDescriptions.deferred: The receiving server asked to try later; Nodera retries.
eventDescriptions.suppressed: Not sent: the address is on the project's Suppressions.
eventDescriptions.complained: The recipient marked it as spam.

logs.title: Logs
logs.description: Messages of {project} in the last {days} days, newest first.
logs.emptyHint: Messages your software sends show up here within seconds.

detail.title: Message
detail.notFound: Message not found. Logs are kept for 30 days.
detail.recipientsDescription: What happened to each recipient, with the receiving server's answer.
detail.retention: Nodera keeps no message body once delivery is handed over; logs are deleted after 30 days.

suppressions.title: Suppressions
suppressions.description: Addresses {project} no longer sends to, after a permanent bounce or a complaint.
suppressions.removeConfirm: Mail to this address is sent again. Remove it only once the address works again.
suppressions.complaintLocked: The recipient complained, so only Nodera can remove this address. Contact support if it was a mistake.
suppressions.rules: An address that bounces for good, or whose recipient complains, is added here and skipped from then on. A send to it lists the address as suppressed in its answer.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.description: Addresses on your servers that receive the message events of {project}, signed. Up to {max} per project.
webhooks.limitReached: A project can have at most {max} webhooks.
webhooks.emptyDescription: Nodera posts message events (delivered, bounced, complained…) to your server in signed batches.
webhooks.emptyReadOnly: No webhook yet. Owners and developers can add one.

deliveries.title: Deliveries
deliveries.empty: No deliveries in the last 30 days.
deliveries.rules: A failed delivery is retried after 1, 2, 5, 10 and 30 minutes, then 1, 2, 4 and 8 hours, and dropped 24 hours after its first attempt.

webhooks.deleteConfirm: Events stop going to {url}. Deliveries waiting for a retry are dropped.
webhooks.signatureHint: Each delivery is a JSON array signed in its Nodera-Signature header: a timestamp and an HMAC-SHA256 of the timestamp and the body, keyed with the webhook's secret. A failed delivery is retried for 24 hours.

secret.title: Copy the signing secret
secret.description: Your server checks each delivery's Nodera-Signature header with it.
secret.warning: This is the only time the secret is shown; you will not see it again. Without it, delete the webhook and add it again.

form.urlHint: A public HTTPS address of your server.
form.urlTooLong: The URL can have at most {max} characters.
form.urlInvalid: Enter a full URL starting with https://.
form.activeHint: A disabled webhook keeps its settings but receives nothing.
